set system multicast-routing.explanation: Enables a grouping router for the system.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface name, e.g., g-1/0/0.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: Bits of IPv4 subnet mask.

pim sparse-mode.explanation: Enable PIM thinner mode on interface.

pppoe-server bind [parameter3].explanation: Tie the PPPE server to a virtual template.

parameters.name: virtual-template
parameters.explanation: Virtual template numbering for PPPOE server configuration.

igmp join-group [parameter3].explanation: Configure the interface to join the specified IGMP group.

parameters.name: multicast-group
parameters.explanation: The IGMP group address to join.

set dhcp pool [parameter1].explanation: This command defines a DHCP pool named `[parameter1]`, which specifies a range of IP addresses to be dynamically assigned to clients by the DHCP server.

parameters.name: pool-name
parameters.explanation: Name of DHCP pool.

network [parameter2]/[parameter3].explanation: Configure the web address and subnet mask of the DHCP pool.

parameters.name: network-address
parameters.explanation: Web address of DHCP pool.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: _Other Organiser

default-router [parameter2].explanation: Configure the default gateway to the DHCP pool.

parameters.name: default-router
parameters.explanation: Default gateway IP address.

dns-server [parameter2].explanation: Configure DNS server addresses for DHCP pool.

parameters.name: dns-server
parameters.explanation: The IP address of the DNS server.

parameters.name: multicast-group
parameters.explanation: Group address.

set aaa multicast-source [parameter1].explanation: Configure the AAA group broadcast source address.

parameters.name: multicast-source
parameters.explanation: Group source address.

set aaa multicast-boundary [parameter1].explanation: Configure AAA teams to broadcast boundaries.

parameters.name: lower-bound
parameters.explanation: The floor of the assembly boundary.

parameters.name: upper-bound
parameters.explanation: The upper limit of the assembly boundary.

set radius-server host [parameter1].explanation: This command configures a RADIUS server host by specifying its IP address or hostname (`[parameter1]`) for authentication, authorization, and accounting (AAA) services.

parameters.name: radius-server-ip
parameters.explanation: IP address of RADIUS server.

secret [parameter2].explanation: Configures the host address and shared key of the RADIUS server.

parameters.name: shared-secret
parameters.explanation: The key shared with the RADIUS server.

set ip local-pool [parameter1].explanation: This command fragment configures a local IP address pool named `[parameter1]` for assigning IP addresses to clients or interfaces in Junos.

parameters.name: pool-name
parameters.explanation: Name of the local IP address pool.

range [parameter2] [parameter3].explanation: Configure the range of the local IP address pool.

parameters.name: start-address
parameters.explanation: The initial address of the IP address pool.

parameters.name: end-address
parameters.explanation: The end of the IP address pool.
